criteria.label: Local Demand
criteria.description: Sufficient demand in your geographic area
fixSuggestions: Research local competitors and their capacity
Start with adjacent services people already pay for

criteria.label: Local Differentiation
criteria.description: Clear reason customers choose you over established competitors
fixSuggestions: Focus on underserved time slots or areas

criteria.label: Operations & Delivery
criteria.description: Ability to reliably deliver service quality
riskIndicators: Dependent on founder for all delivery
fixSuggestions: Plan for hiring help when needed

criteria.label: Pricing & Profitability
criteria.description: Pricing that covers costs and generates profit
fixSuggestions: Calculate true cost per service hour
Build in travel time and overhead

criteria.label: Customer Acquisition
criteria.description: Repeatable way to get local customers
riskIndicators: Not on local platforms (Google, Yelp, Nextdoor)
fixSuggestions: Claim and optimize Google Business Profile

failurePatterns.description: Competing on price leads to unsustainable margins
Can't scale beyond founder's personal capacity
Revenue too seasonal to sustain business
One bad review can significantly hurt business
